name: Quell the Uprising
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Renamed from Quell The Uprising. Pays 40s instead of 60s. Gives 5,550 experience instead of 2,650, 2.09 times as much. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The uprising must be quelled!  I need your assistance.  If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job!  This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one.  But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.

The punishment for insurgency is death.  Kill some of these deviants!  That ought to get things under control.
narrative.objectives: Warden Thelwater of Stormwind wants you to kill 10 Defias Prisoners, 8 Defias Convicts, and 8 Defias Insurgents in The Stockade.
narrative.offerRewardText: Your efforts in The Stockade were valiant, adventurer. It's obvious this problem is bigger than the both of us. But you have performed well and for that I am thankful.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Stockade is still overrun! These Defias Rats must be shown that their actions will not be tolerated. Now get back down there and show some force!
